claims.text: Okonkwo (hamstring) will travel with the Commanders to London ahead of the team's Week 4 game against the Colts this Sunday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

claims.author: Ben Standig
claims.text: Butler is recovering from a concussion ahead of the Commanders' matchup in London against the Colts in Week 4, Ben Standig of The Team 980 Washington D.C. reports.

claims.author: Zach Selby
claims.text: Ekeler signed a one-year contract with the Commanders on Tuesday, Zach Selby of the team's official site reports.
